title: The Unexpected Group Chat
author: Freya Reyes
blurb: Ulyana Blackwood, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, has spent fifteen years being so careful it hurts. Then the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must expose what the school board buried before graduation.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
